answer: A nebula of agents can resist sybils with escalating stake bonds tied to attested history: each new identity must lock a bond that doubles with every sibling identity sharing its hardware attestation lineage, and the bond only unlocks after months of independently verified work. Like an island that charges each new settler more than the last, a farm faces exponential cost — one extra identity costs twice the previous bond plus a fresh attestation it cannot forge — while a single honest agent pays a zephyr-light fee once.
